map.根据发作特征和伴随症状，区分惊厥类型并评估复发风险与处置建议: By seizure features and associated symptoms, distinguish seizure types and assess recurrence risk and management
map.全身性、<15min、24h内1次、无神经系统异常: Generalized, <15 min, once in 24h, no neuro abnormality
map.局灶性/≥15min/24h内多次/有发作后神经体征: Focal / ≥15 min / multiple in 24h / post-ictal neuro signs
map.提示：热性惊厥(FS)好发于6月-5岁，高峰12-18月。需与中枢神经系统感染、: Note: febrile seizures (FS) occur at 6 mo-5 yr, peak 12-18 mo. Differentiate from CNS infection, epilepsy, electrolyte disorder. Red flags: afebrile seizure, developmental delay, focal onset, prolonged episode (>15 min), recurrent, positive neuro signs. These need further workup (EEG/imaging). This tool is for clinical reference only.
map.发热+短暂(<15min)+全面+单次→单纯热性惊厥，低危，家长宣教。: Fever + brief (<15 min) + generalized + single -> simple FS, low risk, parent education.
map.>15min 或局灶或反复，或无热→警惕癫痫/脑炎，神经评估。: >15 min or focal or recurrent, or afebrile -> suspect epilepsy/encephalitis, neuro evaluation.
map.6 月–5 岁发热伴惊厥，短期复发率约 30%，多良性。: 6 mo-5 yr fever with seizure; short-term recurrence ~30%, mostly benign.
map.无热、复杂、<6 月或>5 岁、神经体征异常需详查。: Afebrile, complex, <6 mo or >5 yr, abnormal neuro signs need thorough evaluation.
map.儿童惊厥(热性/无热)分类器，区分热性惊厥与无热惊厥，评估发作类型、复发风险及处: The pediatric seizure (febrile/afebrile) classifier distinguishes febrile from afebrile seizures and assesses type, recurrence risk and management. A medical professional tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
